text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Reporting for duty, sir! Fenomeno, at your 
service!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I intend to devote myself each and every 
day to serve as a proper role model for 
the children!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Let us march down the path of justice 
together, sir!

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
